name: copyFile
description: Copy one file (not a directory) to a new path. Without `overwrite` an existing destination is refused with an `EEXIST: …` message; a missing source answers the Node-style `ENOENT: …`. Returns { ok: true }. Additive action: an older host answers NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

inputs.name: src
inputs.description: Existing file to copy; relative paths resolve against the host cwd.

inputs.name: overwrite
inputs.description: Replace an existing destination. Default false.
